segments.name: Fresh grocery e-commerce
segments.description: Sells fresh groceries, prepared food and other food products and membership services to consumers in mainland China through its Dingdong Fresh app and third-party platforms.
segments.evidence: The Group operates and manages its business as a single segment, in accordance with ASC 280, Segment Reporting .

revenueModel.text: Customers pay upfront for fresh groceries, prepared food and other food products delivered through Dingdong Fresh and for membership services.
revenueModel.evidence: The segment recognizes revenue from (i) product sales of primarily fresh groceries, prepared food and other food products through "Dingdong Fresh" APP, mini program and third-party platforms, and (ii) membership services.
